<!--
HOW TO ENABLE THIS UNITY WEBGL PORTFOLIO PAGE WHEN READY:
1. Export your project from Unity using the WebGL target:
   - In Unity: Project Settings -> Player -> WebGL -> Publishing Settings:
     enable "Decompression Fallback" (or set "Compression Format" to "Disabled"),
     because GitHub Pages does not serve custom Content-Encoding headers for .br/.gz files.
   - Note: GitHub has a 100 MB per-file limit. If your build exceeds that, host it on itch.io
     (even as unlisted) and point the iframe `src` below to the itch.io embed URL.
2. Copy the exported WebGL build files (index.html, Build/, TemplateData/) into `unity-build/`.
3. Below, remove/comment out the "Placeholder" block and uncomment the "Click-to-Play Unity WebGL" block
   (keep the ```{=html} raw block wrapper so Pandoc does not treat indented HTML as code).
4. In `_quarto.yml`, uncomment the `interactive.qmd` entry under `website.navbar.left`.
5. Run `quarto render` to rebuild `docs/`.
-->

  </small>
  <button id="unity-fullscreen-btn" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" disabled>

<script>
(function () {
  const stage = document.getElementById("unity-stage");
  const overlay = document.getElementById("unity-launch-overlay");
  const launchBtn = document.getElementById("unity-launch-btn");
  const fsBtn = document.getElementById("unity-fullscreen-btn");
  if (!stage || !launchBtn || !fsBtn) return;

  launchBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = "unity-build/index.html";
    iframe.title = "Michele Lamon — Interactive Unity Portfolio";
    iframe.allow = "fullscreen; autoplay";
    iframe.loading = "eager";

    overlay.remove();
    stage.appendChild(iframe);
    fsBtn.disabled = false;
  });

  fsBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (stage.requestFullscreen) {
      stage.requestFullscreen();
    }
  });
})();
</script>
